--==========================================================
-- SQL PRACTICE QUESTIONS
-- GROUP BY + ORDER BY + HAVING + CASE
--==========================================================


--==========================================================
-- 1. COUNTRY-WISE SALES PERFORMANCE
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Find total sales generated by each country.
-- Display country and total sales.
-- Sort from highest sales to lowest sales.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- SUM()
-- ORDER BY DESC

SELECT country,
       SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;


--==========================================================
-- 2. CATEGORY-WISE REVENUE
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Find total sales for each category.
-- Display only categories having sales greater than 100000.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- SUM()
-- HAVING

SELECT category,
       SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY category
HAVING SUM(sales_amount) > 100000;


--==========================================================
-- 3. COUNTRY-WISE NUMBER OF TRANSACTIONS
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Find the number of transactions for every country.
-- Display only countries having more than 40 transactions.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- COUNT()
-- HAVING

SELECT country,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;


--==========================================================
-- 4. CATEGORY-WISE AVERAGE ORDER VALUE
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Find the average sales amount for each category.
-- Display only categories where average sales amount
-- is greater than 5000.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- AVG()
-- HAVING

SELECT category,
       AVG(sales_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY category
HAVING AVG(sales_amount) > 5000;


--==========================================================
-- 5. COUNTRY + CATEGORY ANALYSIS
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Calculate total sales generated by every country
-- for each product category.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY multiple columns
-- SUM()

SELECT country,
       category,
       SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY country,
         category;


--==========================================================
-- 6. PAYMENT METHOD ANALYSIS
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Calculate the number of transactions and
-- total sales amount for each payment method.
-- Display only payment methods used for
-- at least 50 transactions.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- COUNT()
-- SUM()
-- HAVING

SELECT payment_method,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY payment_method
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50;


--==========================================================
-- 7. PRODUCT PERFORMANCE
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Calculate total quantity sold and total revenue
-- for every product.
-- Display only products where quantity sold > 50.
-- Sort by quantity sold in descending order.

-- Concepts:
-- GROUP BY
-- SUM()
-- HAVING
-- ORDER BY DESC

SELECT product,
       SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
       SUM(sales_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM retail_sales
GROUP BY product
HAVING SUM(quantity) > 50
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;


--==========================================================
-- 8. SALES VALUE CLASSIFICATION
--==========================================================

-- Requirement:
-- Create a new column called sales_level
-- using CASE expression.

-- Example:
-- 50000 or more     → High
-- 10000 or more     → Medium
-- Below 10000       → Low

SELECT sale_id,
       product,
       sales_amount,

       CASE
           WHEN sales_amount >= 50000
               THEN 'High'

           WHEN sales_amount >= 10000
               THEN 'Medium'

           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS sales_level

FROM retail_sales;


--==========================================================
-- QUICK REVISION
--==========================================================

SUM()
    → Calculate total

COUNT()
    → Count rows / transactions

AVG()
    → Calculate average

GROUP BY
    → Create groups

HAVING
    → Filter grouped results

ORDER BY DESC
    → Highest to lowest

CASE
    → Create conditions / categories


--==========================================================
-- MAIN TRICK
--==========================================================

-- Country-wise
--     → GROUP BY country

-- Category-wise
--     → GROUP BY category

-- Country + Category
--     → GROUP BY country, category

-- Total
--     → SUM()

-- Number of transactions
--     → COUNT(*)

-- Average
--     → AVG()

-- Filter normal rows
--     → WHERE

-- Filter SUM/COUNT/AVG
--     → HAVING

-- Highest → Lowest
--     → ORDER BY ... DESC


--==========================================================
-- EASY MEMORY FORMULA
--==========================================================

-- WHAT DO YOU WANT?
--       ↓
-- Total       → SUM()
-- Count       → COUNT()
-- Average     → AVG()
--       ↓
-- HOW DO YOU WANT?
--       ↓
-- Country-wise       → GROUP BY country
-- Category-wise      → GROUP BY category
-- Country + Category → GROUP BY country, category
--       ↓
-- NEED FILTER?
--       ↓
-- Normal rows         → WHERE
-- Grouped result      → HAVING
--       ↓
-- NEED SORTING?
--       ↓
-- Highest → Lowest    → ORDER BY DESC
